title: Remove PDF export, fix Models Save action, and fix duplicate inputs

requirements.summary: Remove PDF export option entirely from the Export tab
acceptanceCriteria: The Export tab no longer displays a PDF export button or any PDF-related UI.
No PDF export functionality is triggered from any part of the application.
CSV export option remains intact and functional.

file_operations.description: Remove the PDF export button/UI and any references to the usePdfExport hook. Keep only the CSV export functionality with its free-tier warnings and disabled states.
Delete the usePdfExport hook file entirely as it is no longer needed.

Remove the @media print block and all print-specific styles that were used for PDF export (e.g., .print\:hidden, .print\:block, body print styles). Keep all other styles intact including the Tailwind base layers and theme CSS custom properties.

requirements.summary: Fix the failing 'Save' action for projects in SaveProjectModal
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Save' in the SaveProjectModal successfully persists the project to the backend.
A success toast notification is shown after a successful save.
An error toast or message is shown if the save fails.
No unhandled exceptions are thrown during the save flow.

file_operations.description: Investigate and fix the handleSave function. Ensure it correctly calls the useSaveProject mutation from useQueries.ts, handles success with a toast notification, handles errors gracefully with error toast, and closes the modal on success. Verify that all required fields from the MiningProject interface are included when calling the backend saveProject method.

Review the useSaveProject mutation to ensure it correctly calls actor.saveProject with the full project object, properly handles the SaveProjectResult response, invalidates the 'projects' query key on success to refresh project lists, and throws descriptive errors on failure.

requirements.summary: Fix duplicate Equity Ratio and Interest Rate fields in the Inputs dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Equity Ratio appears exactly once in the Inputs dashboard.
Interest Rate appears exactly once in the Inputs dashboard.
Both fields remain functional and correctly bound to the ProjectContext state.
No other input fields are accidentally removed or duplicated.

file_operations.description: Audit the component structure to identify where Equity Ratio and Interest Rate are rendered twice. Check if FinancingSection and EconomicParametersSection are both rendering these fields. Remove the duplicate renderings while ensuring each field appears exactly once in the appropriate section.

Verify that this component renders Equity Ratio and Interest Rate exactly once each. If duplicates exist within this file (e.g., fields rendered in multiple places), remove the duplicate instances while preserving the correct bindings to ProjectContext state.
Check if this section is incorrectly rendering Equity Ratio and Interest Rate fields. If they appear here, remove them as they should only be in FinancingSection. Ensure no other fields are affected.
